otherwise.does: The fresh answer of a query that answers numbers is decided next, for the number drawn. No value answered before has been given yet.
The fresh answer of a query that answers texts is decided next, for the text drawn. No value answered before has been given yet.

behaviors.description: The fresh answer: the value drawn, if it is not one of the values answered before (the same number, or the same text). Otherwise, if it is a number, one more than the largest number answered before; if it is a text, the text drawn followed by "#" and the number of values answered before (counting every value given, of either kind).
behaviors.name: Fresh

behaviors.description: The answer of a query that promises never to answer less than before. If it has not answered before (`previous` is null), the value drawn. Otherwise the previous answer plus the increment `delta`, but not more than `max` when a maximum is given.
behaviors.name: Increasing

behaviors.description: The system restarts. A component that is durable keeps its state and data; any other starts again.
behaviors.name: Restart

otherwise.does: A number the query answered before.
A text the query answered before.

descriptions.component: Turns answers drawn at random into answers that keep a dependency's promises, and decides what survives a restart.
descriptions.data.freshDrawn: The value drawn for the fresh answer being decided (a number or a text).
descriptions.data.used: The values answered before by the query whose fresh answer is being decided, in the order given.

drawnNumbered.description: The text drawn, followed by "#" and the number of values answered before (every value given, of either kind)

increasedAnswer.description: The previous answer plus `delta`, but not more than `max` when `max` is not null

oneMoreThanLargest.description: One more than the largest number among the values answered before

usedWithValue.description: The values answered before given so far, followed by the value just given
